questions.question: What is the title of the main theme that introduces The Elder Scrolls III: Morrowind?
questions.explanation_correct: Nerevar Rising is the iconic opening theme composed by Jeremy Soule that established the melodic foundation for the series.
questions.explanation_incorrect: The other options represent musical tracks or themes from the sequels, specifically Skyrim.

questions.question: Which composer is credited with the SNES orchestral-simulation style of the original Star Fox?
questions.explanation_correct: Hajime Hirasawa arranged the distinct chip-tune orchestral themes for the original Star Fox.
questions.explanation_incorrect: These composers are legends in gaming but did not handle this specific Nintendo project.

questions.question: Who composed the intense opening theme for SoulCalibur?
questions.explanation_correct: Junichi Nakatsuru is widely recognized for his composition work on the initial SoulCalibur title themes.
questions.explanation_incorrect: The other options are primarily famous for their contributions to long-running Japanese RPG franchises.

questions.question: Which composer is responsible for the whimsical and melodic score of Banjo-Kazooie?
questions.explanation_correct: Grant Kirkhope created the playful, lighthearted score that became a staple of the Banjo-Kazooie franchise.
questions.explanation_incorrect: David Wise and Robin Beanland are also iconic Rare composers, but they were not the lead on this title.

questions.question: Who served as the lead composer for Fire Emblem: Awakening?
questions.explanation_correct: Hiroki Morishita directed the music and served as the lead composer for this tactical RPG.
questions.explanation_incorrect: Yuka Tsujiyoko is the series veteran, while the others serve as auxiliary members of the sound team.
